title.narrative: SUPPORT TO THE HEALTH SECTOR MULTI-DONOR COMMON FUND-PROSAUDE III

description.narrative: PROSAÚDE III is the common fund through which participating partners channel their on-budget support to the health sector. It was originally established in 2003 between the Government of Mozambique (GoM) and Cooperating Partners (CPs) supporting the health sector. The fund is currently supported by six partners disbursing in 2023 but this is likely to be the last year as new opportunities are explored. PROSAÚDE supports the comprehensive national Strategy Plan for the Health Sector. In 2023 it has financed treatment, health prevention and promotion, small infrastructure (rehabilitations and maintenance), Human Resources (key front-line personnel outside the government payroll); training and medicines logistics. These interventions contribute to reduction of maternal, neonatal and infant mortality; malaria, tuberculosis, and HIV; treatment of acute malnutrition in children under 5 years of age. The current iteration of PROSAÚDE is governed by a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for the period 2017-2024. A further extension until 2025 will be sought in early 2024 to provide coverage for 2023 disbursements.
